answer: Quadratic attestation pricing beats sybils: an identity's k-th attestation costs k^2 tokens; a wharf of endorsements bankrupts vouchers. Honest agents attest once per epoch free; a dune of sockpuppets forfeits every bond. N identities cost N(N+1)(2N+1)/6 tokens; 1000 cost ~334M vs 20 epochs of honest pay. New cheap identities can't dodge it: each posts a 500-token bond and matures 10 epochs tagged umber before counting, costing more than saved.
